description: Verifies the tidal and rotational perturbation models: the lunar tide changes the Earth C20 coefficient by a small non-zero amount, the direct tidal acceleration of a satellite on the Earth-Moon axis is purely radial, and the rotational flattening reproduces the Earth J2.

checks.label: the lunar tide modifies the normalized C20 coefficient
the tidal acceleration has a non-zero component along the Earth-Moon axis
the transverse y component vanishes on the axis
the transverse z component vanishes on the axis
the rotational contribution to J2 is within 1e-4 of 1.08e-3
